subject.title: Require explicit Keychain interaction for Chromium cookies

question: Should SweetCookieKit permanently expose `BrowserCookieKeychainAccessGate.withUserInteractionDisallowed` as public host-scoped API for background imports?
rationale: The branch adds a new public concurrency-scoped policy rather than only repairing private lookup behavior, and repository history does not establish that public contract.

options.title: Accept after fallback repair
options.body: Keep the public scoped API, require the two-phase alias lookup, focused compatibility coverage, documentation, and redacted live macOS proof.

options.title: Keep policy internal
options.body: Repair the lookup behavior without publishing a new general host policy until a broader API shape is chosen.

options.title: Decline the policy surface
options.body: Preserve the released interactive behavior and close the PR if hosts should not control Keychain interaction through this package.

recommendation.title: Accept after fallback repair
recommendation.body: Keep the public scoped API, require the two-phase alias lookup, focused compatibility coverage, documentation, and redacted live macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored and released the current Safe Storage implementation and is best positioned to set the public API contract.
